name: coding-progress-tracker
description: Faculty coding progress tracking web application

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run prisma:generate && npm test && npm run build
scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate && npm run build
